parsed_json.up: Select distinct chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for molecules linked to document CHEMBL1138844. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id filtering by chembl_id CHEMBL1138844. Inner join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical_smiles. Return chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles.
